dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave spline following the trailing edge from the posterior basal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the maximum vertical morphology.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.4 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, distinct protrusion with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum's dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cyan-green chromatic cast over the entire visible subject body.
